title: Enable Business Central debug logs in Event Viewer

facts.text: Server events are collected in Debug logs under Applications and Services Logs for DynamicsNAV Server and Common.
Debug logs are disabled by default and may be hidden in Event Viewer.
Open Event Viewer on the computer running the server.
Navigate to Applications and Services Logs > Microsoft > DynamicsNAV > Server or Common.
Show Analytic and Debug Logs from the View menu if Debug log is not visible.
Select Debug log and choose Enable Log from the Actions menu.
Default log size is 1028 KB; increase if needed based on event volume.
